_comment: Replayed into user scope by bootstrap.sh via `claude mcp add-json -s user`. Every credential is a ${VAR} reference resolved from the env block bootstrap.sh generates out of secrets.env, so no key is ever committed here.
_note_github_oauth: github uses a PAT rather than OAuth on purpose. api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ does not support dynamic client registration, and Claude Code's `claude mcp login` requires it, so the flow fails with 'Incompatible auth server'. See anthropics/claude-code#3433 and #3273. Use a fine-grained token with the narrowest scopes you need.
